promenadeanglais.name: Promenade des Anglais
promenadeanglais.slogan: Seven kilometres of sea, one blue chair at a time.
promenadeanglais.line: It began in 1820 as a winter relief project that put the town's beggars to work, funded by English residents.

collinechateau.name: Castle Hill
collinechateau.slogan: The whole Baie des Anges, framed from the old citadel's rock.
collinechateau.line: The hilltop citadel and its ramparts were demolished in 1706, the year after the siege of Nice.

courssaleya.name: Cours Saleya Market
courssaleya.slogan: Flowers at dawn, socca by noon, Old Nice in between.
courssaleya.line: The city approved its first flower, fruit and vegetable market on the Cours Saleya on 22 July 1861.

villaephrussi.name: Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild
villaephrussi.slogan: A pink palace on Cap Ferrat, laid out like a ship.
villaephrussi.line: Baroness Béatrice de Rothschild designed its nine gardens as a ship's deck, inspired by a voyage on the liner Île de France.

jardinexotiqueeze.name: Èze Village
jardinexotiqueeze.slogan: A cactus garden on the ruins of a castle, 400 metres above the sea.
jardinexotiqueeze.line: The medieval village of Èze perches on a cliff 427 metres above sea level, often called an eagle's nest.
